messages:
Maya (PM): Quick callout  need a final scope cut for the Console observability push. Customers want cost + traces + errors, but ops warns about egress. Propose a narrow GA path and a clear follow-up list.
Arjun (Eng): Agree narrow. Ship 2 templates (Overview, Cost Hotspots), tenant_id & route tags in spans, default sample_rate 0.5% with pilot-only escalation. Keep sampled trace TTL=7d.
Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: 0.5% ok for pilot. Require per-tenant daily cap (500 traces) and automated throttle at 65% quota. Any escalation must be manual and rate-limited. Add alert to #eng-oncall.
Ben (Data): Per-tenant cost Phase 1 = estimates from aggregated metrics (tokens, compute-ms, model_unit_cost) + confidence band. Phase 2 will be per-span billing. CSV export doable from Phase 1.
Zoe (Design): UX: show "Estimated" badge + confidence tooltip. Dashboards: 3 cards: estimated spend, top routes, confidence. For traces show sample_reason and quick link to full trace for pilot customers.
Carlos (Sales): Pilot customers (Acme, FinTrack, Nova) want CSV export and QBR-friendly numbers. They'll accept estimates if we flag them as such. Confirming pilot list now.
Maya (PM): Draft GA acceptance criteria:
- Dashboards: 2 templates render with pilot data
- Tracing: tenant_id & route tagging, default sample_rate 0.5%
- Cost: estimated per-tenant monthly + CSV export + confidence indicator
- Errors: top-10 fingerprints surfaced, N sampled traces per fingerprint
- Safety: per-tenant cap, auto-throttle at 65%, manual escalation flow
(need ack from Eng/SRE/Data/Design/Sales)
Arjun (Eng): Ack from Eng. Blocker: need a small schema pass to carry tenant_id to the sampler (~3 days). Will open PR.
Priya (SRE): Ack from SRE. Add synthetic load test for sampling before rollout.
Ben (Data): Ack from Data. Will deliver mapping doc and sample dataset in 3 days.
Zoe (Design): Ack from Design. Mocks + microcopy uploaded tomorrow AM.
Carlos (Sales): Ack from Sales. I'll confirm pilot tranche and prepare comms.
Maya (PM): Decision: ship narrow Phase 1 to pilot customers behind feature flag. Action items: Arjun (tenant tag PR + UI toggle) 3d, Priya (throttle + alerts + load test) 5d, Ben (agg pipeline + CSV export) 3d, Zoe (mocks + confidence copy) tomorrow AM, Carlos (pilot comms) EOD.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #1102 queued for branch feature/obs-pilot (1901012500)
Maya (PM): Thanks everyone  reconvene after PR green. Drop blockers to #eng-oncall.
